name: hud_ui_element_set_clip_rect
description: HudUiElement::SetClipRect copies a non-null HudUiRect into the element clip rect and leaves the existing rect unchanged for null input.
known_limits: No VC byte target covers 0x4b41b0 yet; tier S remains open for a later HudUiElement/source-file table pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4b41b0 validates returning immediately for null rect and copying left, top, right, and bottom into HudUiElement::clipRect for non-null input.
The native smoke verifies the non-null copy through SetBltSourceAndClipRect dispatch and directly verifies that a null SetClipRect call preserves the previous clip rectangle.
